name: 服装一致性分析
description: 检测视频中服装图案、纹理和物理行为的时间不一致性。
useCase: Identifying AI生成的 full-body videos through clothing rendering 异常
mechanism: Tracks clothing 模式 details (stripes, logos, text), wrinkle dynamics, and fabric physics 跨 frames. AI生成的 videos often exhibit 模式 warping, disappearing details, physically incorrect fabric behavior, or texture flickering on clothing.
accuracy: Medium - 70-82% on full-body AI生成的 videos
source: Khormali, A. & Yuan, J. (2022) - DFDT: An End-to-End DeepFake Detection Framework, Applied Sciences
algorithm: Texture Tracking + Pattern Consistency + Physical Simulation Comparison
parameters: Texture 特征: LBP + Gabor, Pattern tracking: template matching, Physics: cloth simulation comparison
